rehbars.name: Arisha Rashid Khan
rehbars.story: Earned a 100% scholarship to IBA Karachi after a mentor showed me scholarships were real. Now I help students find the same path.
fullStory: My family could not afford big schools, so I never let myself dream of top universities. I thought they were for other people.
Then a mentor told me what nobody had told me before: scholarships are real, and they are for students like me. I applied, and I got a 100% scholarship to IBA Karachi.

Today I work as an Artificial Intelligence Engineer, and I started MyRehbar so every student gets that same conversation. I am especially happy to help girls and their families feel confident about applying.

rehbars.name: Daniyal Ali
rehbars.story: IBA BBA graduate who can show you what studying business at a top Pakistani university is really like, and how to get there.
fullStory: Daniyal completed a BBA at IBA Karachi, one of Pakistan's leading business schools.
If you are thinking about business, finance or management, Daniyal can help you understand your options, prepare your application, and know what to expect once you get in.

rehbars.name: Aman Razi Kidwai
rehbars.story: Studied Computer Science at IBA and now works in product marketing at Veem Software, bringing together tech and business.
fullStory: Aman studied Computer Science at IBA Karachi and now works in Product Marketing at Veem Software.

Aman's path shows that a computer science degree can lead to many kinds of careers, not only coding. Aman can help you choose a field, plan your applications and think about where your degree can take you.

rehbars.name: Adeen Atif
rehbars.program: AI and Product Head · Computer Science, IBA
rehbars.story: IBA Computer Science graduate who now leads AI and product at Ticket Wala.
fullStory: Adeen studied Computer Science at IBA Karachi and is now the AI and Product Head at Ticket Wala.
If you are curious about computer science, artificial intelligence or building technology products, Adeen can help you understand the path, choose the right degree and prepare strong applications.
